original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can scripts/experiments/inplace_side.py:compile_side replace per-column sorted(unused) pivot search with a least-unused flag scan and column masks so gate lists, pivots, initial matching and certificate small-scalar controls stay fieldwise identical on h in {6,10,14,18,22,26,30}?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling discarded dag_sha256 hand-roll (~1.2× on DisjointTensor.verify; blocked by open #2117 disjoint_tensor.py cert pins), MixedPoint Circuit.add/total micro-opts (~1.0×), and confirmed #1793's open next question on compile_side remains unanswered with identical gate lists.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: compile_side shares the lexicographic pivot rule with the certificate hot-path verify_prefix (#1793) and feeds the h=6/10 small_scalar_controls. Unifying the scan removes a second O(n log n) sort per column. Not a kappa or selected-supplier change.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving compile_side change with frozen baseline, identical gate lists through h=30, singular/mutant/temp-corruption controls, certificate pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median on h in {22,26,30}. Do not reopen the mathematical rejection or run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_INPLACE_SIDE_COMPILE_SCAN via research/inplace-side-compile-scan/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_INPLACE_COMPILE_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py (median 5.696→5.297s, 1.075× on h∈{22,26,30}); certificates/inplace-side.json differs from base only in the inplace_side.py source pin.
